svg.title: The approach
svg.desc: In OpenCode, the plugin teaches the agent the design language. The framework pairs the design viewer with language and execution, and the decision console with the notebook. You ask or correct; the viewers are the surface you review.
svg.text: A language for meaning. An agent that applies it.

text.style: font: 600 10px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #6b7280; letter-spacing: 0.12em;

svg.text: the graph, its plan and a record's constitution
declarations, a plan, a build that can be replaced
the record of what was proposed, decided and measured

text.style: font: 700 24px ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; fill: #ffffff; letter-spacing: 0.18em;
